# `$parley:pr-review`

Review a pull request on a parley page. This is `$parley:code-review` with the PR as the change, plus
what GitHub knows about the PR. Read `$parley:code-review` for the review and the page, and `$parley:parley`
for the loop.

## Input

The argument is a PR number or URL. Read the PR with `gh`:

- `gh pr view <pr> --json number,title,body,author,baseRefName,headRefName,headRefOid,url,labels`
- `gh pr diff <pr>`
- `gh pr checks <pr>`, for the check results. It exits 1 when the PR has no checks; say so in the
  summary.
- `gh pr view <pr> --json comments,reviews`, for what has already been said. Do not raise a finding someone has
  already raised and the author has answered.

To read a file the diff does not show, use `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/<path>?ref=<head
sha>`. Do not check the PR out over the user's work.

## The document

Write `docs/parley/pr-<number>.json`, with the `id` `pr-<number>`. Build it as `$parley:code-review` says, with these changes:

1. The `prose` summary opens with the PR's title, author, base and head, and what the PR says it
   does. Say whether the diff does that.
2. A `table` block of the checks, one row per check with its result, when the PR has checks. Put
   failing checks first.
3. The `diff` block sets `pr` to the PR number, and `base` and `head` to the branch names. The
   document `repo` names the head commit, `headRefOid`.
4. When the PR is open, add a last `single` question to the `question` block: "Post the review to
   the PR?" with options `post` ("Post as a comment") and `keep` ("Do not post"), and `recommended`
   set. A merged or closed PR gets no post question.

## After the review

Follow the loop in `$parley:parley` until the reviewer gives a verdict. Post only when the reviewer chose
"Post as a comment". Then post one review with `gh pr review <pr> --comment --body-file <file>`:
the findings the reviewer kept, in their words where they changed yours, and nothing they dropped.
Never approve, request changes, merge or resolve a thread.
